title: The edge answers the plain /health path with the status of the detection service
expected: Wenn ich über den Eingang per HTTPS /health abfrage, antwortet der Eingang mit 200 und dem Status des Erkennungsdienstes.
whyWrong: The edge routes only /detection/health and /detection/ready (ticket #25, Assumptions); every other path, /health included, answers 404 at the edge and reaches no service (AC9).
